title: Updated my Medieval World Generator
author: Top_Issue_7032
selftext:
Made using Fable 5 Max  
  
Added:  
\-Plate tectonics  
\-Erosion  
\-Rivers  
\-Water effects  
\-Sun and atmosphere

There is a 500 year history simulation as well that grows cities, trade routes, wars, plagues, rebellions, noble houses, and succession for those houses.

All generated in about a second

Curious to know what you guys think, what can be improved, what directions I could take this.

I made something similar using Opus 4.5 and the finished app took 15 minutes to generate a similar result.
